label: Flutter: Pick iOS Simulator (boot if needed)
command: bash -l -c 'SIM=$(xcrun simctl list devices available -j | python3 -c "import json,sys; devs=[(v[\"state\"],v[\"name\"],v[\"udid\"]) for k,vs in json.load(sys.stdin)[\"devices\"].items() for v in vs if v[\"isAvailable\"]]; [print(\"[{:<8}]  {:<30}  {}\".format(s[:8],n,u)) for s,n,u in sorted(devs)]"); SELECTED=$(echo "$SIM" | fzf --prompt="Select iOS Simulator: " --ansi); [ -z "$SELECTED" ] && exit 0; UDID=$(echo "$SELECTED" | awk "{print \$NF}"); STATE=$(echo "$SELECTED" | grep -o \"Booted\" || echo \"Shutdown\"); if [ "$STATE" != "Booted" ]; then   echo \"Booting simulator...\";   xcrun simctl boot \"$UDID\";   open -a Simulator;   sleep 4; fi; flutter run -d \"$UDID\"'

label: Flutter: Pick Android Emulator (boot if needed)
command: bash -l -c 'AVD=$(flutter emulators 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^(Pixel|android|emulator)" | awk "{print \$1}" | fzf --prompt="Select Android Emulator: "); [ -z "$AVD" ] && exit 0; echo "Launching $AVD..."; flutter emulators --launch "$AVD"; echo "Waiting for boot (this may take ~15s)..."; sleep 15; flutter run -d "$AVD"'
